aetherui.configuration.enableCustomHud.t: Custom HUD with armor/held item durability. Hidden in creative/spectator.
Show block/entity info at bottom-right in all game modes.
aetherui.configuration.enableWorldHealth: Show billboard health bars above mobs and animals.
aetherui.configuration.hideVanillaBars.t: Hide vanilla health/armor/food/air/experience bars. Hotbar is not affected.
aetherui.configuration.showArmorDurabili: Show 4 armor pieces icon and durability.
aetherui.configuration.showDemo.tooltip: Show AetherUI demo panel at top-left.
aetherui.configuration.showHeldDurabilit: Show main/off hand item icon and durability.
aetherui.configuration.showNeutralHealth: Show health bars for neutral mobs. Hostile and passive are always shown.
